lines.text: Moses tells the tribal heads a man who vows to the LORD must do everything he promised.
If a young woman in her father's house vows and he prohibits her that day, the LORD absolves her.
If a woman marries while under a vow and her husband says nothing that day, her vow stands.
Every vow a widow or divorced woman pledges to fulfill is binding on a priest.
If a husband nullifies his wife's vows after he hears of them, he will bear his father's iniquity.
